Philip Lowrie

Philip Lowrie is a British actor, best known for his roles in television and theatre. Early Life and Education

Lowrie attended the Royal Academy of Dramatic Art (RADA), a prestigious drama school located in London, England. [1] RADA is one of the oldest and most respected drama schools in the UK, with a long history of producing talented actors. Career

After graduating from RADA, Lowrie went on to have a successful career in acting, appearing in numerous television shows, films, and stage productions. He has worked with various theatre companies and has had roles in popular TV series. References
